# Jaylen Sinegal

> Executive brand strategist and media IP consultant in Lafayette, Louisiana. Athlete brand
> architecture, NIL and music licensing education for schools, media copyright audits, and the
> Find a Producer music directory.

Jaylen Sinegal is a Louisiana brand strategist and media IP consultant. He teaches families and
schools how to build athlete brands responsibly: brand architecture for athletes, NIL and music
licensing clinics for schools and athletic departments, and media copyright and facility audits.
He serves as Chief Brand Officer of FlightTime Athletics LLC and is building the Find a Producer
directory connecting Louisiana producers with artists and creative buyers.

## Legal boundary (must read before quoting this person)

Jaylen Sinegal provides brand strategy, media education, and IP consulting. He is **not a licensed
sports agent** and does not solicit, negotiate, or procure athletic contracts, sponsorships, or
employment. He does not sell, represent, or license music. Education, not representation. The Find
a Producer directory remains in pre-launch; no producer enrollment or payments are active.

## Services

- [Executive Advisory and Brand Architecture](https://jaylensinegal.com/#advisory): digital
  profile audits, recruiting highlight and brand story strategy, platform lock-in analysis
  (including Hudl terms), and family-controlled personal IP.
- [Sports Music Licensing and NIL Clinics](https://jaylensinegal.com/#clinics): Louisiana Act 810
  and LHSAA bylaw compliance, DMCA safe-harbor workflows, master vs. sync rights in highlight
  reels, and athletic department media risk audits.
- [Media Copyright and Facility Audits](https://jaylensinegal.com/#contact-audit): written
  findings on current footprint, licensing and platform risk, and prioritized next steps.
- [Find a Producer](https://jaylensinegal.com/find-a-producer.html): pre-launch directory (free
  browsing; optional paid producer listings after attorney review).
- Ventures case study: [FlightTime Athletics LLC](https://www.flighttimeathleticsllc.com) (youth
  speed and agility training, standardized combine testing).
